title: Local food experience recommended!
text: This tour was exactly what we had been hoping for. Tapas and wine at the spots where locals enjoy them, everything was incredibly fresh and tasty, and the prices were fantastic! Eva, our guide, shared so much interesting information about the local culture and history. We would definitely love to do this tour again.
author: simonaw105

title: A Great Way to Discover Barcelona
text: Lucía was absolutely wonderful. We felt like we were hanging out with an old friend while discovering Barcelona and eating and drinking our way through a couple of truly local places and a popular one as well. Highly recommend to anyone who is new in town wanting to get a better understanding of the city and all the wonderful things it has to offer.
author: juniperm2026

title: An Exceptional Barcelona Experience
text: Elena couldn’t have been a better tour guide! Incredibly friendly, deeply knowledgeable and immensely passionate about Barcelona, she showed us where to go (and what to try) around the heart of Barcelona’s historic areas. Elena’s insights into Barcelona’s food, drink, history, and culture are unparalleled!
author: lukassT5055CY

title: Tasting  Barcelona like a local
text: My wife and I were absolutely delighted to explore the city through a local's eyes. Marta was incredibly knowledgeable, fun, and truly a pleasure to spend time with. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona who enjoys history, delicious food and drinks, and great conversation.
author: 321piotrf

title: Outstanding!
text: Samon was amazing!  We had experienced everything we wanted and more.  Samon made us laugh and Samon was very informative! Highly recommend!
author: Marianne_D

title: Would absolutely do it again
text: Marc met up with us and took our group to some really great spots to try local tapas around Barcelona. I’m usually a picky eater, but there honestly wasn’t anything I wouldn’t try. He made sure everyone’s preferences were taken into account and always offered other options if something wasn’t for us. I would genuinely do this tour a hundred times again in such an amazing city.
author: 960vegam

title: We made a new friend in Barcelona from Ireland
text: It is not often you can experience such an intimate tour as the one we enjoyed last night with our guide Brian. He was knowledgeable, sociable, funny, and a great human being to spend an evening with.
author: Amy B

title: Perfect afternoon in Gothic Quarter - Pinchos and cava with a great private tour guide.
text: Wonderful in every way! We couldn’t think of a better way to explore the Gothic Quarter and Markets than with our private tour guide, Simon who led us to several amazingly, quaint and delicious places where we tasted our way through the afternoon. (Not to mention plenty of cava and wine) Their knowledge of the area was perfect and we learned a little about the history and even some current events. We would highly recommend the tour, and Simon.
author: Nicole B

title: So full and so happy
text: Our time with Mateo was really fun! He took us to some of his favorite places in Barcelona for pinxos and to a very cool wine bar we would have never found by ourselves. We also tried crema catalana and it was incredible. The conversation flowed easily and we finished the tour completely full.
author: tiffanynE8425HC

title: Eating like a local
text: Clara was incredible! We felt totally at ease from the start, honestly like we were just hanging out with a close pal. She took us to some fantastic hidden gems with huge servings, and we tried so many unique, tasty dishes that we definitely would’ve overlooked on our own.
author: louisannef2025
